ahtools.risk.title: Ban risk warning
ahtools.risk.body: The AH seller and the command spammer send commands to DonutSMP for you. Automation can break the server rules, and it can get your account muted or banned. The spammer sends exactly what you give it, plain chat included. You use these features at your own risk, and the author is not responsible for any punishment. The sales tracker and the profit HUD only read chat and are not part of this warning.
ahtools.msg.emergency_stop: emergency stop: seller and spammer off, queued message dropped
ahtools.msg.world_changed: world changed: seller and spammer stopped
ahtools.preset.name: Name
ahtools.hud_screen.title: Move the profit HUD
ahtools.hud_screen.hint: Drag to move, Escape to save
ahtools.tip.debug_logging: Writes every automated command and every matched chat line to the game log. Only useful when something goes wrong.
ahtools.tip.accent: Color of the panel highlights and the HUD separators. Click to cycle.
ahtools.tip.hud: Shows session profit at the top of the screen.
ahtools.tip.hud_rate: Adds profit per hour to the HUD. Hidden for the first minute of a session, while the number would be meaningless.
ahtools.tip.hud_sales: Adds how many listings sold this session to the HUD.
ahtools.tip.reposition_hud: Drag the HUD where you want it. It snaps to the center. Escape saves.
ahtools.tip.seller_toggle: Starts or stops the AH seller with the selected preset. It lists hotbar items with /ah sell, one slot at a time.
ahtools.tip.seller_preset: Which preset the seller uses. Left and right click cycle through them. Make presets in the Presets tab.
ahtools.tip.emergency_stop: Stops the seller and the spammer at once and drops any command waiting to be sent.
ahtools.tip.preset_add: Type a name and press Enter to create a preset with safe defaults. Names must be unique.
ahtools.tip.preset_row: Click to show or hide this preset's settings. The highlighted one is selected.
ahtools.tip.preset_select: Makes this the preset the seller uses.
ahtools.tip.preset_delete: Deletes this preset. Its statistics stay.
ahtools.tip.preset.name: The preset's name. Statistics are kept under it.
ahtools.tip.preset.expected_item: Item id the seller may sell, like filled_map. Every other hotbar item is left alone. Empty means it sells anything in the hotbar.
ahtools.tip.preset.pricing_mode: Fixed lists every item at one price. Random range picks a price between the minimum and maximum, in steps.
ahtools.tip.preset.fixed_price: Price for one whole listing in fixed mode. A full stack and a single item both list at this price. Accepts 5k, 1.5M and so on.
ahtools.tip.preset.min_price: Lowest price random range mode may pick.
ahtools.tip.preset.max_price: Highest price random range mode may pick.
ahtools.tip.preset.step: Random range prices are the minimum plus a whole number of these steps.
ahtools.tip.preset.max_price_cap: Safety ceiling. The seller stops instead of sending any price above this.
ahtools.tip.preset.delay_mode: Fixed waits the same time between commands. Random rolls a new wait each time.
ahtools.tip.preset.fixed_delay: Wait between commands, in ticks. 20 ticks is one second and the hard minimum.
ahtools.tip.preset.min_delay: Shortest random wait, in ticks. Never below 20.
ahtools.tip.preset.cost_per_item: What one item cost you to get. Used only to turn sales into profit in the statistics.
ahtools.tip.preset.validate_hotbar: Refuses to start the seller if any hotbar slot holds something other than the expected item.
ahtools.tip.stats_session: Since the game started or the last session reset. Click for revenue, cost, items and sales.
ahtools.tip.stats_today: Since midnight on your computer's clock.
ahtools.tip.stats_lifetime: Everything recorded so far. Click for the breakdown.
ahtools.tip.stats_preset: All time totals for this preset.
ahtools.tip.stats_unattributed: Sales the mod could not match to a listing it made, such as offline payouts. Revenue only, no cost.
ahtools.tip.reset_session: Clears the session totals and restarts the HUD's hourly rate.
ahtools.tip.reset_lifetime: Clears everything. Type RESET and press Enter. A backup of the file is saved first.
ahtools.tip.spammer_toggle: Starts or stops sending the command list below, in order, on repeat.
ahtools.tip.spammer_random_delay: Rolls a new wait between the minimum and maximum for every message.
ahtools.tip.spammer_delay: Wait between messages, in ticks, when random delay is off. Drag, or right click to type a number.
ahtools.tip.spammer_min_delay: Shortest random wait, in ticks. Never below 20.
ahtools.tip.spammer_commands: Click to show the list. Lines starting with / are commands, anything else is sent as chat.
ahtools.tip.spammer_add: Type a command and press Enter to add it to the end of the list.
ahtools.tip.github: Opens the AHTools page on GitHub, where the source lives and bugs get reported. The game asks before opening your browser.
ahtools.tip.website: Opens the author's website. The game asks before opening your browser.
